summary: RETEST of iteration 210 CRITICAL fix — bulk-update-unified now accepts arbitrary Configure-driven keys. Backend pytest suite (3/3 pass): (a) posting bag_weight_kg=25 + coverage_m2_per_bag=3.5 + warranty='5 years' + bag_colour='White' returned success:true, verification_ok:true, verification_failures:[] AND direct MongoDB inspection confirmed all four fields persisted; (b) blank-string clear now $unsets the field (warranty='' removes it — previously silent no-op); (c) reserved keys (is_builtin, id, verification_ok, password_hash) are correctly blocked from mutating the doc. Frontend E2E: /admin/materials → select 3 rows → Specs/Filters modal → coverage_m2_per_bag=5.5 + pack_size='20kg' → Apply → toast 'Applied 2 fields to 3 products' → DB confirms both fields on 355POL6060, 4405, 5225. Add-via-Configure promise verified: added 'Warranty' filter via Configure → immediately visible in Specs/Filters modal → typed '2 years' → Apply → toast 'Applied 1 field to 3 products' → DB confirms warranty='2 years' on all 3 products. All dirty data cleaned up post-test.

minor.issue: iter210 minor finding still open: the endpoint's own GET /api/supplier-sync/products/{supplier}/{sku} does NOT project non-whitelisted extras (bag_weight_kg / coverage_m2_per_bag / warranty appear null on GET even though MongoDB has them). Not a bulk-update bug — separate GET-side projection whitelist. Main agent already flagged this.

action_items: OPTIONAL: extend GET /api/supplier-sync/products/{supplier}/{sku} to return Configure-driven extras so admins can immediately see the value they just saved via bulk edit without a Mongo peek.
OPTIONAL: iter210 design finding — custom-manager grout-sealants has empty Specs/Filters modal until Configure seeds facets/spec_fields (not blocking, admin can self-seed).
OPTIONAL: iter210 design finding — Tiles Configure default spec_fields still lack options[] on material/finish/slip_rating and are missing edge/type rows.
critical_code_review_comments: The new extras block in supplier_sync.py (line 11584) is clean, minimal and correctly plumbs list values into array_updates, non-empty scalars into set_fields, and None/'' into unset_fields — matches the verifier's re-read loop, so verification_ok is now honest.
RESERVED_SYSTEM_KEYS set correctly guards id, supplier, sku, is_builtin, verification_ok, password_hash from being writeable via user-supplied updates{}.
seed_data_creation: Wrote coverage_m2_per_bag/pack_size/warranty on SKUs 355POL6060, 4405, 5225 during E2E — all $unset via mongo after test. Added 'Warranty' filter to manager_definitions.materials.filter_facets during Configure test — removed via mongo after test (facets restored to original 4). Backend pytest also wrote+unset on ULT-GGI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The bulk-update-unified silent-drop bug is fully fixed. If future iterations touch this endpoint, /app/backend/tests/test_bulk_update_unified_extras.py is a regression guard (3 tests: arbitrary-key persistence + verification_ok, blank-clear $unset, reserved-key protection). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env.
